messages:
Nina Ortiz: Quick sync 1: we need a short SLO summary + evidence bundle for Meridian ahead of renewal. Minimal and transparent.
Caleb Ruiz: I can assemble the packet. Do we include p50/p95/p99 or just p95/p99?
Anya Volkov: Customer asked for p95 and p99. Add p50 as internal context. Keep charts tiny.
Ethan Gomez: Ops will provide: minute-level uptime CSV, latency percentiles, incident IDs, and cache warmstart split. Filing OPS ticket now.
Nina Ortiz: Also include a 1-line executive summary: "No service degradation affecting core routes" or "X minutes degraded".
Caleb Ruiz: Drafted the two-page packet: page 1 = SLOs + summary; page 2 = credit calc worked example + reconciliation notes. Posting draft shortly.
Anya Volkov: Credit calc formula we use: credit_pct = round(((SLO_baseline - observed) / (1 - SLO_baseline)) * 100, 2). Add a concrete dollar example.
Ethan Gomez: Ops ETA for exports: EOD. Ticket #OPS-7478. Will attach traces and note maintenance windows.
Nina Ortiz: Schedule a 20-min rehearsal before the renewal call. Thurs 11:00 PT proposed.
CS Bot: Calendar invite created for Thu 11:00 PT. Checklist attached.
Caleb Ruiz: I'll lead the packet walkthrough; Anya does the evidence; Nina handles Q&A. Keep updates here only. :white_check_mark:
